answer: The crystal schedule is applied in nebula and anchor exposes each instalment. A payout is split thus 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3081 identities would post 2037 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
